purpose: Implementation acceptance requirements; no implementation was executed as part of this audit.
note: 核心条目必须有真实证据。某条确实不适用时需经范围审查并记录理由，不能通过改成pass或静默删除处理。Artifact内部unknown/not_applicable与需求验收not_run是不同语义。
